text:
Maya: Heads-up from NovaGrid (satcom SI). They plan to switch to a compacted hourly export and will sometimes emit "reclaim_token" events when a device replays older windows. Their ask: accept backfills up to 10 days and automatically reconcile to customer ledgers. Need quick policy call on max auto-credit window and reclaim semantics.

Partner Bot: posted schema v1.2 and example payloads to partner portal; sample bundle uploaded.

Nina: 10 days auto-credit is too open-ended. we should separate "ingest window" (how far back we accept data) from "autocredit window" (how far back credits apply automatically). finance will not accept 10d auto-credit.

Derek: technical note: NovaGrid's "reclaim_token" looks like a mechanism to mark previous batches as superseded. If we persist (partner_id, device_id, compact_token) and mark previous windows as reclaimed when a reclaim_token arrives, we can avoid double credits. but we need strict monotonicity guarantees or signed manifests.

Partner Bot: sample payload: 
```
{
  "partner":"novagrid",
  "device":"NG-9001",
  "window_start":"2026-03-10T08:00:00Z",
  "window_end":"2026-03-10T09:00:00Z",
  "units": 2048,
  "compact_token":"ctok_20260310_9001_42",
  "reclaim_token": null,
  "signed":"sig_v1:..."
}
```

Eli: ops impact: support will need a clear audit trail showing original ingest vs reclaimed adjustments. Console should show a timeline and ability to view preceding compact tokens for any ledger row.

Nina: finance preferred autocredit window = 48h. we can extend to 72h for partners who meet stronger guarantees (signed manifests + monotonic compact_token + SLA). ingest window up to 14d for visibility but anything >72h flagged for manual review.

Derek: proposal for governance: 
- require JWT/HMAC signature on every batch
- persist unique key (partner_id, compact_token) and index by (device, window)
- accept ingest for signed events where window_end >= now-14d
- if signed_at >= now-72h -> apply credits automatically and mark ledger_state=credited
- if now-14d <= window_end < now-72h -> ingest but ledger_state=review_required (no credits)
- reclaim_token semantics: when a reclaim_token arrives referencing prior compact_token(s), mark prior ledger rows as reclaimed and generate a reversal operation only if the original credit was applied automatically (and within 72h). beyond 72h reclaim -> create manual ticket.

Maya: partner insists they need reclamation handled automatically because some satellite handoffs repeat earlier packets. they stress compacted payloads reduce size but can cause reorder.

Nina: finance will accept this if we add: (a) daily replay volume telemetry and (b) a cap for pilot (e.g., $10k/month liability) and rollback triggers (>0.3% of daily revenue in reclaimed auto-credits).

Partner Bot: uploaded test set: s3://novagrid-tests/compact-replay-20260322.tar.gz

Derek: I'll add a compact-token uniqueness constraint and a small worker that applies reclaim semantics idempotently. Implementation plan: 2 dev days + 1 day QA. Also add an "apply_credit" feature flag so we can toggle auto-credit for this partner.

Eli: Console changes: show fields: compact_token, reclaim_token, signed_at, ledger_state, applied_credit_amount, and a link to the raw signed payload. also create canned response templates for support.

CI Bot: queued replay-sim job (#NG-5010) against s3://novagrid-tests/compact-replay-20260322.tar.gz; estimated run 90m.

Maya: owners: Derek (eng) for idempotency+reclaim worker + feature flag, Nina (finance) for pilot cap & rollback, Eli (support/ops) for Console + KB, Maya (partnerships) to negotiate pilot terms. I'll propose ingest window = 14d, default autocredit = 48h, pilot autocredit = 72h with signed manifests and monotonic compact_token, reclaim auto-apply only within autocredit window.

Derek: one more technical detail: we should store both the original compact_token and a "compacted_signature" (hash of the payload manifest) so reclaim proofs are verifiable. also log a pre/post ledger snapshot for every reclaim.

Nina: agreed. finance wants daily alerts if reclaim volume > 0.05% of revenue so we can step in earlier than rollback trigger.

Partner Bot: NovaGrid PM: "We can emit `compact_token` + signed manifest and opt into pilot. We understand you'll only auto-apply reclaims within the configured autocredit window."

Maya: thanks team. I'll tell NovaGrid we can pilot with those guardrails. follow-ups tracked in #PRT-5010 and ticket NG-89. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
